free_tier.stated: You can deploy certain Render service types free of charge ... Free instances have important limitations, described below. Do not use them for production applications.

egress.terms: Hobby workspace included bandwidth: 5 GB per month. Above that, $0.15 per GB, or the workspace is spun down until the next month.; ingress: http-only
egress.free_allowance: Hobby workspace included bandwidth: 5 GB per month. Above that, $0.15 per GB, or the workspace is spun down until the next month.

tooling: Git push or Dockerfile; no port configuration beyond PORT.
chaining: Render can host the HTTP side of a stack; it cannot host an endpoint.

limits.value: 5 GB per month on Hobby; $0.15/GB above

binding_note: 5 GB/month is 0.005 TiB. The transport fails first though: no public port other than one HTTP port exists on a free web service.

identity_cost.detail: Free instances need an account; a payment method is optional, and without one Render "spins down your workspace's services until the start of the next month" at the cap.

reliability_note: Free instances spin down when idle; the workspace is spun down at the bandwidth cap if no card is on file.
confidence_note: A probe cannot be run because no non-HTTP public port can be created on a free instance.

evidence.proved: Free web services and static sites; bandwidth counted against workspace allowance
Hobby 5 GB included bandwidth; $0.15/GB public internet; spin-down without a payment method
"Render forwards inbound requests to your web service at this port (it is not directly reachable via the public internet)."

notes: Private services can bind extra ports but only over the private network; the free tier does not include private services. One public HTTP port per service.

extras.wg_detail: HTTP only. "Every Render web service must bind to a port on host 0.0.0.0 to serve HTTP requests ... Render forwards inbound requests to your web service at this port (it is not directly reachable via the public internet)."
extras.volume_stated: Hobby workspace included bandwidth: 5 GB per month. Above that, $0.15 per GB, or the workspace is spun down until the next month.
extras.transit_note: Render terminates HTTP; no raw socket reaches a user.
